messages:
sam: heads-up: deploybot paused orbit-service v2.4.0 canary (us-east) after 11% 503s over 5m. :rotating_light:

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Hold applied on orbit-service@v2.4.0. Trigger: canary error rate > 10% for 5m.

alisa: thanks. any immediate mitigations?

oncall-sre-bot: pulling canary logs and kernel dmesg. early correlation with kvcache eviction jitter after yesterday's kernel param change. sending to #eng-sre.

sam: ok let's not roll forward. plan: pin warm nodes to v2.3.1, abort remaining canary phases, schedule low-traffic backfill.

devops-bot: suggested commands:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/orbit-service orbit=registry/redwood/orbit:2.3.1 --record
kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/orbit-service
```

sam: executed both. warm nodes pinned and rollout paused.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Manual image pin to orbit:2.3.1 recorded by sam. Rollout paused.

alisa: abort canary retries too so it doesn't keep hitting same hosts.

sam: aborted canary jobs and cleared retry hooks.

oncall-sre-bot: SRE will cordon affected node-pool and revert kernel tuning. ETA 20m.

alisa: schedule backfill for 2026-03-22 04:00-06:00 UTC. Owners: alisa (releases), sam (deploy), oncall-sre (SRE).

sam: updated release board and pinned v2.4.0 as "paused - regression". linked incident INC-2026-1199.

oncall-sre-bot: cordon + kernel revert done. nodes rejoining, starting 45m soak. logs uploaded to incident ticket.

alisa: after soak we run regression tests in sandbox and then decide: re-canary v2.4.0 or roll patched v2.4.1.

sam: leaving hold in place until regression tests pass. will not clear automatically.

deploybot: [SYSTEM] Hold will remain until manual clear by release owner.

alisa: notifying stakeholders and updating release notes to mark paused and include next steps.

sam: closing thread, will reopen if plan changes.
